name: getPduResults
description: Read the outcome of PDUs in the current simulation — source, destination, traffic type, and status (accepted/dropped/in_transit/etc). Call after stepSimulation to verify connectivity. Use the types filter to show only ICMP, TCP, etc. and hide STP/DTP background noise.

types.description: Only return frames matching these traffic type names (e.g. ["ICMP"], ["ICMP","ARP"]). Omit to return all frames.
